name: Axon
author: ArcLabs
description: What Axon is running on this machine: live agents, resident models, and the resources they hold.

barWidget.description: One bar icon and one panel: GPU, VRAM, RAM and CPU as the Axon daemon sees them, which models are resident, and which agents are holding them.

schema.label: Show when nothing is running
schema.description: By default the icon leaves the bar entirely when the daemon is down and nothing is resident.

schema.label: Use mock data
schema.description: Feed the views synthetic readings instead of the daemon. For building and reviewing the panel before a daemon is running.

schema.label: Watch command (development)
schema.description: Override what produces the state stream. Empty uses the installed CLI. For working against a source checkout before a build carrying `axon daemon watch` exists.

schema.label: Command prefix (development)
schema.description: Override what runs daemon verbs. Empty uses `axon daemon`. Pairs with the watch override for working against a source checkout.

schema.label: Show the install offer (development)
schema.description: Pretend Axon is not installed, so the first-run install flow can be reviewed on a machine that already has it. Pressing Install still runs the real installer; the pretence lifts as soon as it succeeds.

schema.label: Installer source (development)
schema.description: Where the install script is fetched from. Empty uses the published one. A file:// path runs a working copy, for testing a fix to the script before it is deployed.
